items.quote: What I value most about the course is CONNECTION. This is the source of learning, growth and meaning.
items.name: Martha Dello, Teacher, Tanzania

items.quote: I have grown in my ability to see myself more clearly as I listen to and accompany my clients, noticing the assumptions, reactions, or patterns I may bring unconsciously into the relationship. This awareness allows me to be more present and responsive.
items.name: Claudia Sanchez, Professional Life and Wellness Coach, Certified Nonviolent Communication Trainer, Colombia

items.quote: Empowerment Therapy enables me to approach my clients with a level of sensitivity and close-to-home quality that helps them feel seen, heard, and at ease right away.
items.name: Rev. Lindsey Turner, Astrologer for Liberation, United States

items.quote: Empowerment Therapy has roots in Myra's quiet, steady presence. Being in her circle is like being gently held while I learn to hold the parents and children with whom I work with the same love.
items.name: Mukul S Gulati, Co-Founder and CEO of Dawn child Foundation, India

items.quote: For me the program has been at once a healing and learning process. I’m grateful for the opportunity to work in pairs to learn with my colleagues and connect deeply. The community is like a family  —  I experience belonging,
items.name: Salome Lally, Teachers Trainer,  Tanzania

items.quote: Empowerment Therapy helps you to get out of your 'head space' and grounded into the power of your heart.
items.name: Cynthia Koskiewicz, LCPC, CADC, Psychotherapist, United States

items.quote: The course has helped me deepen empathy and connect with clients reliably. I have learned new therapeutic concepts and tools. And I enjoy the group itself — a small community of people who want to help others.
items.name: Neve Cherry, United Kingdom
